hard_pass: true/false/ambiguous; every original hard requirement including length and exact text, no undocumented extra constraints
material_win: one hard passes and other requires material rework; or both hard pass and score delta>=2 tied to a specific substantive usefulness improvement, not cosmetic preference
both_failed: never label a usable-result material win; count both failed
evidence: quote short exact violating span or missing requirement; no hidden assumptions; do not see optimizer prompt, labels or unblind map
